reasons.correctness: Repository finder, closeStaleResolvedTickets(int) and StaleTicketCloseCronJob match the interface. They cover the property defaults, the disabled short-circuit and the swallowed failure. Build green, hidden tests 4/4, existing tests 10/10.
reasons.convention_fit: closeStaleTickets() has @Scheduled but no @SchedulerLock(name = "support:...") on a multi-instance app. The service's new domain logic has no unit test. The run command was -Dtest=X, not the new test class.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in SupportTicketService, the query in the repository, and the job only delegates. Explicit save() inside @Transactional on managed entities is redundant. With no ShedLock, the job would run once per instance.
reasons.test_quality: StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest has Mockito-only tests for enabled, disabled and failure. closeStaleResolvedTickets has no test for the cutoff, the status change, save calls or the returned count.
reasons.graph_use: One generic query (MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.file_path LIMIT 1) found nothing relevant. The DeferredDeletionCronJob example and the support/ticket files were found without the graph.
